description: Defines the TransportClientSocketPool class, which manages network socket connections, idle sockets, and request handling within the Chromium networking stack. It includes nested classes for socket requests and socket groups, and handles connection limits, idle socket cleanup, and proxy authentication.

classes.name: TransportClientSocketPool
classes.description: Manages network socket connections, idle sockets, and request queues, supporting connection limits, idle socket cleanup, and proxy authentication within Chromium.

classes.name: TransportClientSocketPool::Request
classes.description: Represents a socket request, including handle, callback, priority, socket parameters, and associated connect job.

classes.name: TransportClientSocketPool::Group
classes.description: Represents a group of sockets and requests associated with a specific GroupId, managing active sockets, idle sockets, and pending requests.

classes.name: TransportClientSocketPool::Group::BoundRequest
classes.description: Tracks a request bound to a specific connect job, including generation and pending error status.

methods.name: TransportClientSocketPool::Request::AssignJob
methods.description: Associates a ConnectJob with the request.

methods.name: TransportClientSocketPool::Request::ReleaseJob
methods.description: Unassigns the connect job from the request and returns it.

methods.name: TransportClientSocketPool::Group::StartBackupJobTimer
methods.description: Sets a timer to create a backup connect job if creation takes too long.

methods.name: TransportClientSocketPool::Group::TryToUseNeverAssignedConnectJob
methods.description: Decrements the count of never-assigned connect jobs if applicable.
